summary: Added `logging` for improved observability and error handling. Included `__slots__=True` for `TradeHeartbeat` for memory optimization. Refined type hints for clarity. Enhanced `HeartbeatPublisher.__init__` with validation for `RuntimeContext` and its `crdt` dependency. Updated all internal helper methods (`_fallback_snapshot`, `_best_symbol`, `_best_price`, `_current_fitness`, `_population_diversity`, `_llm_mutations`, `_niche_counts`) to use more robust `getattr` calls with explicit default values and comprehensive `try-except` blocks with `logger.error`/`logger.warning` to prevent silent failures and provide better debugging information.
